clips.title: The story
paras: Shadowhide Pendants are crude ornamental charms carried by the Shadowhide gnolls roaming the Redridge Mountains. Collected as legal proof of bounty enforcement, they signify that local defenders have enacted Lakeshire's law against gnolls collaborating with the rogue mage Morganth.

Carried by warriors, brutes, and spellcasters of the Shadowhide clan, these pendants serve as crude personal totems or rank insignias. Deep in the hills of Redridge, the clan has rallied under Lieutenant Fangore and fallen under the sway of Morganth, a rogue wielder of the Arcane. To the townspeople of Lakeshire, these charms are not mere primitive jewelry; they are identifying marks of an organized menace harassing settlements across the region on behalf of an enemy of the Crown.

Under the authority of Magistrate Solomon and the laws of Stormwind, actively aiding a known criminal of the realm carries a sentence of death. Lacking sufficient royal reinforcements, Bailiff Conacher in the Lakeshire Town Hall relies on independent adventurers to uphold the peace. Presenting ten Shadowhide Pendants provides tangible proof that gnolls obeying Morganth's orders have faced frontier justice.
